newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediobanca sets 500 bln lire Italy floater.
newsitem.headline: Mediobanca sets 500 bln lire Italy floater.

text.p: Italian merchant bank Mediobanca said it is launching on the domestic market a 500 billion lire, 7-year variable-rate bond.
The offer for the Mediobanca 1997-2004 bond will be open on April 3 and 4.
The bonds, issued at par, carry gross quarterly interest based on the three-month Rome Interbank Offered Rate (Ribor) plus 0.60 percent, Mediobanca said in a statement.
Gross interest for the first quarter from April 8 to July 7 has been set at 1.97 percent. Based on the first coupon, the effective annual gross yield is equal to 8.12 percent.
Payment date is April 7, due date April 8 and redemption is at par on expiry. Quotation will be on the Milan bourse.
